soldier: Head yellowish brown, mandibles dark brown, thorax, abdomen and legs yellowish brown. Head capsule rectangular, nearly twice as long as wide, head-width index 0.51–0.54, lateral margins nearly parallel, slightly constricted from the antennal sockets backwards, posterior margin straight and the two posterior lateral corners rounded. Frontal peaks distinctly raised, slightly concave between the two peaks, with several shallow longitudinal striae. Labrum elongate-lanceolate, the apex narrowly rounded, apical, lateral apical and subapical setae present. Mandibles rather stout, apex rather curved, mandibular basal ridge slightly projecting; left mandible about 0.94–0.95 times head width and about 0.49–0.5 times head capsule length, with a small pointed tooth on the left dorsal side of the basal projection. Postmentum about 10.59–11.25 times as long as the waist constriction, waist constriction index 0.29–0.32. Antennae 16–17 segments. Anterior margin of the pronotum formed by two intersecting arcs, posterior margin nearly straight and shallowly incised in the middle, median emargination index about 15%; more than 50 long setae in the middle region.
taxonomy_note: The genus name is printed as Reticuliter mes in the original work, a misspelling of Reticulitermes; the species is here placed in Reticulitermes.
